title: Frog with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- back legs -->
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='78' rx='14' ry='9' fill='#2e8b3a'/>
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='78' rx='14' ry='9' fill='#2e8b3a'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='16' cy='86' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#3cb84a'/>
  <ellipse cx='84' cy='86' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#3cb84a'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='30' ry='24' fill='#46c85a'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='20' ry='15' fill='#a8e86b'/>
  <!-- front legs -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='84' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#3cb84a'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='84' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#3cb84a'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='32' ry='26' fill='#46c85a'/>
  <!-- eye bumps -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='24' r='12' fill='#46c85a'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='24' r='12' fill='#46c85a'/>
  <!-- eye whites -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='22' r='9' fill='#f0fff0'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='22' r='9' fill='#f0fff0'/>
  <!-- irises -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='22' r='6' fill='#c8a020'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='22' r='6' fill='#c8a020'/>
  <!-- pupils -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='22' r='3.5' fill='#2a1a0a'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='22' r='3.5' fill='#2a1a0a'/>
  <!-- sparkles in eyes -->
  <circle cx='34.5' cy='19.5' r='1.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='24' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='70.5' cy='19.5' r='1.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='24' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- extra sparkle stars -->
  <path d='M27 17 l1 2.5 l2.5 1 l-2.5 1 l-1 2.5 l-1 -2.5 l-2.5 -1 l2.5 -1 z' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <path d='M73 17 l1 2.5 l2.5 1 l-2.5 1 l-1 2.5 l-1 -2.5 l-2.5 -1 l2.5 -1 z' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='46' r='5' fill='#ff8fa3' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='46' r='5' fill='#ff8fa3' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- mouth smile -->
  <path d='M38 50 Q50 60 62 50' stroke='#2a6a2e' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- nostrils -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='38' r='1.8' fill='#2a6a2e'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='38' r='1.8' fill='#2a6a2e'/>
  <!-- chin highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='10' ry='3' fill='#b8f08a' opacity='0.5'/>
</svg>
